sources.docker-cli-v29.9.2: https://github.com/docker/cli/tree/v29.9.2: cli/command/formatter/reflect.go (--format '{{json .}}' marshals every exported method of a context without arguments, FullHeader left out), formatter/container.go (docker ps), network/formatter.go (docker network ls), formatter/volume.go (docker volume ls), formatter/image.go (docker image ls), formatter/disk_usage.go (docker system df, one line per Type), system/info.go (docker info --format, a template on the daemon's Info), builder/prune.go (its last line), cli/flags/options.go and container/opts.go, run.go, create.go (the options docker-label.ts skips)
sources.moby-docker-v29.9.2: https://github.com/moby/moby/tree/docker-v29.9.2: api/types/volume/volume.go (docker volume inspect, a JSON list of Volume, CreatedAt, ClusterVolume, Status and UsageData omitted when empty), api/types/system/info.go (DockerRootDir, ServerVersion, SecurityOptions, Warnings), daemon/info.go (name=rootless in SecurityOptions; the warning of an API on TCP without TLS), client/errors.go (the daemon not reachable)
